captions.linkedin:
Most people get generic advice from AI because they ask vague questions and let the AI fill the gaps with assumptions.

Combining two techniques changes that: Reframing and the Cognitive Verifier Pattern (CVP).

First, reframing: ask the AI to rewrite your question with context, a clear goal and a narrower focus.

Then CVP: before answering, the AI lists the sub-questions it needs answered instead of guessing. Once you answer them, it builds a plan from your actual situation.

Reframing sharpens the question. CVP stops the AI from jumping to conclusions. Together they turn AI from a search engine into a thinking tool.

For quick facts and simple, clear questions, a direct answer is enough.

Read more: https://metaxis.io/blog/cvp-and-reframing-in-practice
